subject: Request: pen-test methodology, evidence handback timeline, and retest window
messages:

Subject: Initial: pen test scope / methodology questions and evidence handback

Hi Sarah / OliveSec team,

Quick one as we're compiling materials for Acme's SIG / CAIQ review. They asked for:

- A short explainer of the pen test methodology used (standards referenced, e.g., OWASP Top 10, PTES, etc.)
- Firm credentials / accreditation (lead tester CVs or firm profile)
- Clarification on report "age" acceptance — Acme's security team will only accept reports dated within 12 months of evidence handback. Is the Aug 2025 test we have on file still acceptable if the remediation evidence is provided now?
- A timeline and format for proof-of-remediation artifacts (evidence handback). Acme prefers workpapers or re-test confirmation; they asked whether a summary-only report plus screenshots/patch notes is sufficient.

Can you share a brief note addressing methodology + whether OliveSec can provide: (a) a compact firm profile PDF we can attach to questionnaires, (b) lead tester CVs (redacted), and (c) whether you offer a scoped retest or focused verification and typical SLA for that?

Thanks — Rishi

--

Head of Trust & Security (acting)

Date: 2026-08-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial: pen test scope / methodology questions and evidence handback

Hi Rishi / team — thanks for the note. Short answers below, followed by an attached firm profile and a suggested evidence checklist. See attached: OliveSec_Firm_Profile_2026.pdf and methodology-summary.txt (attached as stubs in thread).

Methodology:
- Primary frameworks referenced: OWASP Top 10, OSSTMM for test design, and PTES for process.
- Test types performed: external blackbox web and API assessments, authenticated app-level tests, and internal network reconnaissance where applicable.
- Tooling: Burp Suite Pro, network scanners, custom exploit validation in dry-run sandbox.

Firm credentials:
- OliveSec is CREST-aligned; lead testers hold OSCP/OSWE and relevant background checks. See attached one-page profile and anonymized CVs.

Report age acceptance:
- We understand many customers insist on a 12-month window. The key is whether findings were re-verified after remediation. If the original test date is >12 months but we perform a focused verification (retest) on remediated items, Acme can accept the verification + original report as evidence.
- We can do a focused verification for high/critical items only — typical turnaround 7–10 business days depending on repro steps and access.

Evidence handback options:
- Full workpapers (redacted) + PoC evidence (screenshots, logs) — preferred for enterprise auditors.
- Summary-only report + remediation checklist + screenshots — acceptable for lower-sensitivity reviews but may trigger additional questions from audit teams.
- We offer a scoped re-test certificate (one-page confirmation) that explicitly references the original report and lists items re-tested. That usually satisfies procurement/security gates.

Fees & contracting note:
- Focused verification is charged as a small add-on (estimate attached). We can issue a SOW/quote if you want to proceed.

Let me know if you want OliveSec to run the verification and I can loop in our PM to draft a statement of work.

Regards,
OliveSec Reporting
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Initial: pen test scope / methodology questions and evidence handback

Thanks — that's helpful. A couple quick clarifications for Acme's security team:

1) If OliveSec issues a "scoped re-test certificate" referencing the original report and enumerating re-tested CVEs/finding IDs, will Acme accept that as a replacement for a full re-test? (Sarah — can you confirm Acme's exact acceptance criteria?)

2) For the focused verification, we need guidance on the evidence format that Acme will accept in their SIG submission. Monica, can you capture the minimum artifact set we should ask OliveSec for (e.g., screenshot + logs + patch diff or traceroute) and whether we should insist on workpapers?

3) If OliveSec's lead tester leaves redwood-specific exploit code in PoC attachments that we cannot share externally, can OliveSec provide redacted PoC and a separate tester affidavit? We need something that preserves technical veracity without exposing sensitive PoC in public attachments.

Action items: OliveSec — please send a short SOW for the focused verification with estimated days and cost. Monica — can you draft the acceptance checklist for Acme? Marissa — I'll loop you in on any contract approvals.

Thanks,
Rishi
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Olive Security <reporting@olivesec.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T10:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial: pen test scope / methodology questions and evidence handback

Rishi / team — draft acceptance checklist below (will load to Drive link once finalized):

Minimum evidence set for Acme SIG/CAIQ:
- Signed firm profile (one-page)
- Original pen-test report (PDF)
- Scoped re-test certificate or re-test report (if >12 months) listing re-tested finding IDs
- For each remediated finding: short remediation note (1–2 lines), screenshot of validated fix, timestamped server logs or curl output showing the fixed behavior (sanitized), and a patch note or PR link where available
- Redacted PoC (if PoC contains vendor-specific exploit code) + tester affidavit (one-paragraph confirming test steps and outcome)

Prefer full workpapers for critical/high items. If OliveSec can provide the scoped re-test certificate plus the artifacts above, that should be acceptable for Procurement.

I've attached a remediation tracker template (remediation_tracker_rishi_v1.xlsx) with columns for finding ID, severity, owner, remediation notes, evidence link, and verification status.

I'll coordinate with Sarah on acceptable formats from Acme.

--
Monica Patel
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks — appreciate the checklist. We're happy to proceed with a focused verification SOW. Quick notes:

- SOW outline: 3–5 business days effort depending on number of findings (we priced this based on up to 10 findings). Includes scoped re-test certificate, redacted PoC artifacts, screenshots, and timestamped verification logs.
- Evidence delivery: we will upload a zipped evidence package to your secure Drive share and include a one-page tester affidavit.
- Redaction approach: testers will redact exploit code and include sanitized PoC plus a separate secure-only appendix (available under NDA) if Acme requests full workpapers.
- Pricing and SOW doc: attached as OliveSec_SOW_focused_verification_v1.pdf (stub).

Next steps: Please confirm (a) approval to proceed with SOW; (b) preferred Drive upload folder (we'll use the link you provided unless you name another); and (c) a target date for verification (we can start as early as 2026-09-01).

Best,
OliveSec Reporting
